# Blast-radius corpus provenance

The files in `testdata/blast-radius/` are copied verbatim from the Varve
`varve` gallery:

- Source checkout: `${VARVE_SRC:-../varve}`
- Path in that repo: `gallery/blast-radius/corpus/*.spdx.json.gz` (twelve SBOMs)
  and `gallery/blast-radius/cve/cve-2021-44228.json` (one CVE attestation).
- Copied on 2026-08-07.

The twelve SBOMs are syft 1.49.0 SPDX documents (`syft 1.49.0`, platform
`linux/amd64`), one per container image. Their per-run `documentNamespace` UUID
and `creationInfo.created` are normalised away in the gallery so the files are
byte-reproducible; see the gallery's `corpus/MANIFEST` for the sha256 truth
table and the AFFECTED/CONTROL verdict per image.

The AFFECTED/CONTROL split (7 affected, 5 control) is derived from the
`log4j-core` version syft found inside each image — CVE-2021-44228 affects
`2.0-beta9` through `2.14.1`:

- AFFECTED (7): solr, flink, logstash, elasticsearch, sonarqube, neo4j, druid
- CONTROL (5): kibana, odoo, jenkins, tomcat, nginx

`cve-2021-44228.json` is an in-toto vulnerability attestation (osv.dev scanner)
whose subjects are the vulnerable `pkg:maven/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-core`
versions.

## Committed gzipped; decompressed at demo time

The SBOMs are committed **gzipped** (~1 MB total; ~15 MB decompressed). The
demo script (`scripts/blast-radius.sh`) decompresses them into a temporary work
dir at run time because GUAC v1.1.0's file collector cannot read gzip — it
ingests every file in the target directory as-is with no decompression and no
extension filter (spec §10). Only the plain `.spdx.json` files and the CVE json
are placed in the work dir that is handed to `sluice ingest files`.
